svg.title: Positive volume observables and finite-site Hamiltonians
svg.desc: A triple-grasp volume observable is compared with four-site hopping and repulsion Hamiltonians, emphasizing that volume was usually measured separately from the Hamiltonian.
svg.text: Volume is a positive geometric readout; dynamics come from H
Finite four-site singlet studies diagonalized a hopping-plus-repulsion Hamiltonian and measured volume on its states.
1 · Triple grasp and positive volume
Orientation-sensitive
triple flux
Rovelli–Smolin (RS)
Ashtekar–Lewandowski (AL)
The mean positive volume is not the square root of the mean signed grasp.
Project normalization omits physical regularization factors.
2 · Four-site singlet Hamiltonian
solid: 4-site ring
dashed: complete-graph
extra hopping bonds
Spin-zero sectors at total areas 2, 3, and 4; both boson species hop.
In the baseline, V is measured separately.
Onsite repulsion commutes with volume; hopping changes it.
Thermal volume varies nonmonotonically with energy weights.
Separate runs tested positive/negative volume couplings and signed grasp;
These terms are outside the baseline Hamiltonian.
Four-site spectra and normalized volumes are not a continuum limit.
